land_notes: Coordinates are the application point from the West Lothian Council portal records (via PlanIt mirror; PAC point 55.856204,-3.59266 and EIA screening point 55.856854,-3.594571; parish Stoneyburn, ward Fauldhouse & The Breich Valley).
